phases.objective: Replace manual reconstruction of Frontend surface dispatch failures with one exact-candidate structured report, produce and apply a bounded exact-operation OpenAPI auth repair through the registered generated-artifact maintenance tool without widening document defaults, keep pull-request validation read-only, and delegate repository mutation through a label-gated exact-head workflow dispatch that emits its own structured evidence.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Read-only Frontend surface dispatch on a pull request, with the generated-artifact-refresh label enabling a separately dispatched governed exact-head refresh
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The pull-request workflow publishes bounded JSON and Markdown identifying the first failed verification stage or proving all checks, the dispatcher records its API decision without writing repository contents, and the registered exact-head maintenance tool applies only the reviewed canonical and generated files with a canonical mutation report.
steps: Checkout the exact pull-request candidate without persisted credentials for validation.
Fetch the canonical default branch and force the local canonical ref to the fetched origin ref.
Validate that auth sync inserts operation-level security while preserving unrelated document-level defaults.
Generate bounded canonical OpenAPI auth repairs in the ephemeral runner workspace.
Generate frontend dispatch, operation-governance, and runtime OpenAPI evidence against that exact canonical ref.
Reject changes outside openapi.yaml, openapi/support-tickets.yaml, and the governed generated evidence set.
Run each frontend verification command as a named ordered evidence stage.
Check committed generated-output parity as a named evidence stage.
Stop at the first failure and retain bounded redacted diagnostics.
Upload the structured report and bounded repair files before enforcing the decision.
Keep the pull-request verification workflow read-only with no repository push capability.
On a governed work-branch push, resolve the open same-repository pull request and require the generated-artifact-refresh label.
Validate target branch, exact head SHA, protected-branch rejection, and typed confirmation before dispatch.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh.yml on main with target_ref, expected_head_sha, and APPLY_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_REFRESH.
Publish mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch.v1 with HTTP decision, associated PR, exact head, and bounded diagnostics.
Re-check local and remote exact-head identity immediately before the registered mutator commits and pushes.
Commit only registered canonical and generated files by non-force push.
Publish mad4b.governed-generated-artifact-refresh.v1 as the mutation evidence source.
assertions: Pull-request evidence records merge-candidate SHA separately from source-head SHA.
Validation and governed refresh both move local main to origin/main after fetching.
Canonical auth repair inserts exact operation-level security and never widens a mixed document root security default.
Unrelated inherited public operations remain unchanged.
The report names the first failed verification stage and exit code.
Diagnostics are bounded and redact authorization values, OAuth tokens, secrets, API keys, passwords, cookies, GitHub tokens, and JWT-shaped values.
Job logs are diagnostic-only and are consulted only when bounded structured diagnostics are absent.
The pull-request verification workflow has contents read permission only and contains no git push.
The dispatcher performs no direct contents write and skips when the required PR label is absent.
The dispatcher rejects main, Production, malformed branches, and non-exact SHAs before API dispatch.
The dispatched mutator remains workflow_dispatch-only and requires exact-head typed confirmation.
The maintenance tool refuses stale local heads and stale remote heads.
The registered repair write set includes only the reviewed canonical OpenAPI and generated contract files.

phases.objective: Route the verification, dispatch, and mutation reports through the trusted canonical PR evidence publisher after the workflow definitions are present on the default branch.

Exercise dispatch authorization rejection, process spawn faults, missing reports, oversized diagnostics, stale candidates, concurrent refresh pushes, mixed-profile canonical documents, write-set violations, and artifact upload failures.
Observe the first non-production label-gated exact-head dispatch and verify reviewers no longer require manual Job-log reading.
Require canonical structured frontend verification evidence for protected release promotion while keeping protected branches outside refresh mutation scope.
